reason: I already have more work than I can handle and I'm planning to hand the business over in a few years, so I don't need more enquiries coming in. If someone misses me they call the next guy, and that's fine by me. I'm not paying 990 euros plus a monthly fee to collect jobs I'd turn down anyway.
objection: It's another subscription and another thing to set up from a brand new company with no customers, when I'm trying to wind things down, not grow.
would_change_my_mind: If it could politely tell callers we're fully booked and sort out only my existing regular customers' urgent jobs, with no setup fee and nothing to manage myself.
